statements.text: Good Flippin Design operates 25 web properties. 16 have an owner-declared status (10 active, 3 incubating, 3 aliases); 9 have none, so their intent is shown as unknown.
19 of 20 properties that publish a site are responding; 3 are verified healthy end-to-end. None is failing. 1 property is blocked from view (not counted as failing). 4 domains publish nothing.
Usage cannot be stated yet: the governed traffic source is awaiting authorization, so no request, growth or contribution figure is shown (and none is estimated).
No property reports business outcomes yet: 6 declare an intended outcome and 3 have event-producing routes that are not connected. "Zero conversions" cannot be stated for any of them.
15 open items: 2 actionable now, 4 blocked on missing authority, 8 need a decision. First: 0 of 20 properties report business outcomes.

funnel.question: How many meaningful actions happened, and where?

nextUp.title: 0 of 20 properties report business outcomes
nextUp.why: Traffic without outcomes cannot show that the estate produces value: leads, sign-ups, purchases and downloads are what an investor asks about after audience.
nextUp.action: Start with the properties whose producers already exist in source: publish counts to the globaldeets-business-events-feed contract (per property, event type and window) and set the events feed secrets.

risks.title: Certify human audience metrics
risks.why: Operational edge telemetry cannot responsibly stand in for human traction. Investors will ask how many real people use this.
risks.action: Connect certified GA4/RUM-quality audience ingestion (history ingestion seam: certified-audience) with explicit bot, monitor, API, asset, and Mission Control probe exclusions.

risks.title: 0 of 20 properties report business outcomes
risks.why: Traffic without outcomes cannot show that the estate produces value: leads, sign-ups, purchases and downloads are what an investor asks about after audience.
risks.action: Start with the properties whose producers already exist in source: publish counts to the globaldeets-business-events-feed contract (per property, event type and window) and set the events feed secrets.

risks.title: 1 property ships an analytics tag with a placeholder ID
risks.why: The page looks instrumented while measuring nothing, which would silently hide its audience.
risks.action: Replace the placeholder with the real GA4 measurement ID (or remove the tag) and redeploy.

risks.title: Connect the governed audience source (awaiting authorization)
risks.why: Without a governed traffic source, usage, growth and each property's contribution cannot be stated at all. Nothing is estimated or shown as zero.
risks.action: Grant Mission Control read access: A read credential for the governed Canonical Gold and Traffic Insights documents. Then set the repository secrets MISSION_CONTROL_GOLD_SOURCE and MISSION_CONTROL_GOLD_TOKEN.

opportunities.title: Quantify Culture Sherpa convergence opportunity
opportunities.why: The integration thesis could improve differentiation and depth, but should be supported by actual overlap and utility evidence.
opportunities.action: Measure cross-navigation, overlap, unique utility, search demand, and content reuse before making convergence claims.

opportunities.title: 12 of 20 properties have no declared primary outcome
opportunities.why: A property with no declared outcome cannot be judged useful, whatever its traffic.
opportunities.action: Owners declare one primary outcome per property from the common vocabulary (visit, engagement, CTA, lead, sign-up, application, purchase, download, or another declared outcome).

gaps.title: Accumulate enough comparable history for 7/28/90-day trends
gaps.why: Trend charts become decision-grade only when they contain comparable observations rather than decorative lines.
gaps.action: Scheduled collection accumulates snapshots automatically; connect the governed audience source to add comparable traffic points.

gaps.title: 12 of 20 properties have no declared primary outcome
gaps.why: A property with no declared outcome cannot be judged useful, whatever its traffic.
gaps.action: Owners declare one primary outcome per property from the common vocabulary (visit, engagement, CTA, lead, sign-up, application, purchase, download, or another declared outcome).

gaps.title: 16 of 20 serving properties still need an owner-declared critical path
gaps.why: Reachable-unverified is not verified health; only owned, contracted paths can prove the product works.
gaps.action: Each property owner names the one route or function that proves the product works (API endpoint, key page, search) and Mission Control adds it to the registry.

gaps.title: 1 property could not be assessed from any vantage (probe blocked)
gaps.why: Blocked probes leave real outages invisible.
gaps.action: Allow-list the probe user agent / X-GlobalDeets-Probe header for these hosts (Cloudflare WAF, zone owner) or register an authenticated health path.

gaps.title: 4 domains publish nothing and their intent is not declared
gaps.why: Owned domains that publish nothing waste brand surface, and without a declared intent no one can tell a deliberate reservation from an abandoned project.
gaps.action: Decide per domain: reserve it (record it as intentionally unpublished), publish a placeholder, redirect to a primary property, or release it.
